items.description: preview record shape mismatch: computeResultPreview did not fulfil the client postgame contract (record.core.*) — deployed preview would crash Postgame on flag enable
items.resolutionEvidence: root cause: previewEngine returned an engine-native shape while the client renders record.core.*; rewritten to fulfil the production postgame contract from possession output only (compatCore-equivalent, winning-side composite MVP, engine-agnostic pregame edges); regression-protected by tests/v6c5 production-shaped-record suite; vitest 1981/1981

items.description: pv_ result ids unreadable: GET /api/game and /api/narrative rejected the preview id shape and read only production namespaces
items.resolutionEvidence: root cause: GET /api/game and /api/narrative validated only the production id shape; pv_ ids now resolve in preview-result and cache under preview-narrative, never production namespaces; regression-protected by tests/v6c5 preview-scoped-reads suite
